summary: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a firm-commitment underwritten public offering of 10,810,811 shares of common stock at $18.50 per share, with an underwriters' option for an additional 1,621,621 shares. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Proceeds will go to the company. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other extraordinary event. The filing is a standard shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5). Risk-arb or special-situations analysis is not applicable.
